_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice, empty reasoning object has no control: no effort/summary keys means exact passthrough with no upstream reasoning field and no loss. Future-expected (source: plan_reasoning controls empty when effort None). RED on baseline: empty object currently hard-refuses 400, zero upstream IO.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_empty_reasoning_no_control
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
